title: The Lucky Brass Tray #shorts
description:
People used to bang it to call someone home. Now they bang it to close a sale.
▶ Full episode: {LONG_URL_P04}

A fictional story inspired by Vietnamese folklore about the ma giau — the hider ghost who hides people until their family bangs a brass tray and calls their name. Characters and events are fictional. Voices and images were made with AI.

New episodes every few days. Subscribe @ThePettyGhost — a petty little house ghost tells you what the living get up to.
